name: Water Flow Volume Analysis → Pattern Load Capacity
metaphor: Replace 'how strong is the signal?' with 'how many traders can surf this before it collapses?'
implementation: Track 13F filings, ETF flows, retail order flow. Pattern collapses when institutional adoption exceeds threshold (the rock erodes). Use Perplexity to monitor: 'How many hedge funds are discussing [momentum/value/trend] in latest letters?'
data_sources: ['13F filings via Perplexity', 'ETF creation/redemption data', 'Retail flow proxies (Robinhood trends)', 'Hedge fund letter sentiment']
signal: Pattern capacity = (historical Sharpe) × (1 - crowding_coefficient)
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: patterns decay as capital crowds them. Dalio: regime shifts when everyone positioned same way.

name: Static Backtests → Dynamic Pattern Lifespan Tracking
metaphor: Replace 'did this work 2010-2020?' with 'when did the rock form, peak, and erode?'
implementation: Rolling-window regime analysis. For each pattern (momentum, mean-reversion, breakout), compute: birth_date (when Sharpe >1), peak_date (max Sharpe), decay_date (Sharpe <0.5). Use Perplexity: 'When did [factor] become mainstream academic/practitioner knowledge?'
data_sources: ['Academic publication dates', 'Google Trends for trading terms', 'Factor returns by cohort (pre-publication vs post)']
signal: Pattern age since publication = current_date - first_major_paper_date. Decay accelerates post-publication.
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: 'Edges decay'. Dalio: 'Markets adapt to what worked in the past'.

name: Price-Only Patterns → Multi-Domain Rock Formation
metaphor: Replace chart patterns with 'what created the rock?' (policy, macro, structure)
implementation: Patterns emerge from *underlying forces*, not just price. Example: 'End-of-quarter window dressing' is a rock created by institutional reporting cycles. Use Perplexity: 'What regulatory/structural forces create predictable market behaviors in [sector/timeframe]?'
data_sources: ['Regulatory calendar (FOMC, NFP, earnings)', 'Institutional constraints (13F deadlines, rebalance dates)', 'Tax calendar (loss harvesting)']
signal: Structural pattern = events with multi-year recurrence + documented behavioral response.
varma_dalio_fit: Dalio: 'Understand the machine'. Structural forces persist longer than purely statistical patterns.

name: Regime Classification × Pattern Lifespan
metaphor: Rocks (patterns) exist in different parts of the river (regimes). Same rock, different flow = different surf quality.
implementation: Test each pattern separately in LOW/MED/HIGH risk regimes. Momentum works above 200DMA but fails below. Use 5-factor regime (vol, correlation, credit, sentiment, trend). Ask Perplexity: 'Which market patterns historically perform in [specific regime combo]?'
data_sources: ['VIX percentile', 'Correlation matrix', 'Credit spreads', 'AAII sentiment', '200DMA classification']
signal: Pattern_regime_fit = sharpe_in_regime / sharpe_overall. >1.5 = regime-specific edge.
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: risk-first classification. Dalio: environment determines what works.

name: Early-Warning Risk × Pattern Invalidation
metaphor: Upstream rocks (future events) that will destroy downstream patterns. See the avalanche coming.
implementation: Your early-warning system detects 'rocks ahead'. If MSI >60 (high macro shock risk), patterns that require LOW vol (mean-reversion, high-frequency arb) will break. Use structural fragility score to predict which patterns collapse. Ask Perplexity: 'What macro events historically invalidated [momentum/value/carry] strategies?'
data_sources: ['Early-warning MSI/SSI from your spec', 'Historical pattern performance during crises', 'Debt-cycle phase']
signal: Pattern_survival_prob = 1 - (MSI/100 × pattern_vol_sensitivity). High MSI + high vol-sensitivity = pattern collapse imminent.
varma_dalio_fit: Dalio: debt cycles determine regime shifts. Varma: cut exposure when regime shifts, don't force trades.

name: Breadth Divergence × Narrative Shift
metaphor: The river narrows (fewer stocks participating) while headline flow looks strong. Rock is shifting underwater.
implementation: Combine market breadth (% stocks above 200DMA) with news narrative tone. When S&P up but breadth <40%, pattern weakening. Use Perplexity: 'What % of S&P sectors are declining despite index gains?' + news sentiment on 'narrowing rally, concentration risk'.
data_sources: ['Market breadth (% above 200DMA, A/D line)', 'Sector rotation', 'News sentiment via Perplexity']
signal: Divergence_score = |index_return - median_stock_return|. >2 stdev = pattern exhaustion.
varma_dalio_fit: Classic regime-shift warning. Varma: react to divergence. Dalio: watch internal contradictions.

name: Seasonal Pattern Tuning by Regime
metaphor: Same rock, different season (spring melt vs summer drought). Water flow changes, surfing technique adapts.
implementation: January effect works differently in LOW vs HIGH vol regimes. Tax-loss harvesting bounce is stronger after HIGH vol Decembers. Use Perplexity: 'How does [seasonal pattern] perform in different volatility environments historically?'
data_sources: ['Seasonal returns by regime', 'VIX term structure', 'Historical calendar anomalies']
signal: Seasonal_strength = (baseline_effect) × (regime_multiplier). Jan effect = 2% × 0.5 in HIGH vol, 2% × 1.3 in LOW vol.
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: regime-adaptive rules. Dalio: same event, different context = different outcome.

name: Dynamic Stop-Loss by Pattern Confidence
metaphor: If the rock is stable (high confidence pattern), tight leash. If rock is new/untested, loose leash (might work differently).
implementation: Patterns with >10 years of data get 1.5 ATR stops. New patterns (<3 years) get 3 ATR stops (more exploration room). Use pattern_age and pattern_consistency to scale stops. Ask Perplexity: 'When was [trading pattern] first documented? How consistent has performance been?'
data_sources: ['Academic publication history', 'Factor returns consistency (Sharpe by 3-year window)', 'Regime-specific drawdown history']
signal: Stop_distance = base_ATR × (1 + (1 - pattern_confidence)). Low confidence = wider stops.
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: process over outcome. Dalio: principle-based rules, not discretion.

name: Correlation Regime → Pattern Independence Filter
metaphor: When all surfers fall at once (high correlation), the river changed. Only surf uncorrelated patterns.
implementation: In HIGH correlation regimes (>0.7 avg stock correlation), only trade patterns that historically showed LOW correlation to S&P. Use Perplexity: 'Which trading strategies have low beta to equity markets during crises?'
data_sources: ['Rolling 60-day stock correlation', 'Strategy beta to SPY by regime', 'Cross-asset correlation (stocks-bonds-commodities)']
signal: Pattern_allowed = (pattern_correlation_to_market < 0.5) OR (current_regime == LOW_CORRELATION).
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: don't force trades when markets correlated (systemic risk). Dalio: diversification only works when correlations low.

name: Pattern Entry Timing → Kuzushi (Off-Balance) Detection
metaphor: Don't surf the rock when everyone's on it. Wait for them to fall off (off-balance moment), then enter.
implementation: Momentum patterns work best after a reversion shakeout. Wait for 3-5 day pullback in uptrend before entering long. Use Perplexity: 'What are typical retracement depths before trend continuation in [asset class]?'
data_sources: ['Intraday volatility spikes', 'Short-term sentiment reversals (AAII flips)', 'Volume exhaustion patterns']
signal: Entry_signal = (trend_up) AND (3day_pullback >= 0.5 ATR) AND (volume_spike_down). Off-balance entry.
varma_dalio_fit: Wu wei: wait for natural openings. Kuzushi: exploit moments of instability.

name: Pattern Timeframe Compression/Extension by Regime
metaphor: In fast water (high vol), patterns resolve faster. In slow water (low vol), patterns take longer.
implementation: In HIGH vol regimes (VIX >30), momentum patterns resolve in 5-10 days. In LOW vol (VIX <15), patterns take 20-30 days. Adjust holding periods accordingly. Ask Perplexity: 'How does market volatility affect pattern duration historically?'
data_sources: ['VIX regime', 'Pattern duration by vol regime (empirical)', 'Realized vol vs pattern speed']
signal: Expected_duration = base_duration × (15 / current_VIX). VIX 30 → 2x faster, VIX 7.5 → 2x slower.
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: regime determines behavior. Dalio: velocity of change varies by environment.

name: Pattern Signal Strength → Multi-Timeframe Confirmation
metaphor: A rock creating ripples on surface (short-term) AND deep current (long-term) = high confidence. Surface-only = weak.
implementation: Require confirmation across 3 timeframes: daily, weekly, monthly. RSI oversold on daily but weekly/monthly still strong = stronger signal than daily alone. Use Perplexity: 'What are best multi-timeframe confirmation strategies for [pattern type]?'
data_sources: ['Daily, weekly, monthly price/indicator data', 'Cross-timeframe divergence analysis']
signal: Pattern_strength = count(timeframes_aligned) / 3. All 3 aligned = 1.0 (max confidence).
varma_dalio_fit: Multiple independent signals confirm regime (Varma's 3+ cross-asset confirmation approach).

name: News Narrative Patterns → Sentiment Exhaustion Detection
metaphor: Watch how surfers talk about the rock. When everyone's bragging (euphoria), rock about to collapse.
implementation: Track narrative intensity via Perplexity news searches. When 'AI stocks', 'crypto', 'meme stocks' hit 90th percentile of mentions + sentiment, pattern exhaustion. Ask Perplexity: 'Show me news mention frequency and sentiment for [theme] over past 12 months.'
data_sources: ['Google Trends', 'News mention count via Perplexity', 'Sentiment analysis (AAII, news tone)']
signal: Narrative_exhaustion = (mention_count > 90th pct) AND (sentiment > 80th pct). Contrarian signal.
varma_dalio_fit: Sentiment extremes precede reversals (Varma SCAMPER idea #4). Dalio: bubbles require extreme consensus.

name: Patent Filing Trends → Sector Innovation Cycles
metaphor: Upstream prospectors staking claims (patents) = future rocks forming. Early signal of sector shifts.
implementation: Track patent filings in pharma, semiconductors, energy. Spike in AI chip patents 2016-2018 preceded NVDA run 2019-2023. Use Perplexity: 'What sectors have seen largest increase in patent filings in past 2 years?'
data_sources: ['USPTO patent data via Perplexity', 'Sector-specific innovation metrics', 'R&D spending trends']
signal: Innovation_momentum = (patent_count_recent_3y / patent_count_prior_3y) - 1. >50% increase = early signal.
varma_dalio_fit: Dalio: understand causal mechanisms. Long-term sector shifts driven by innovation cycles.

name: Insider Transaction Patterns → Regime Confidence
metaphor: River guides (insiders) loading up kayaks (buying stock) = they know safe path. Guides selling = danger ahead.
implementation: Track insider buying/selling ratios. Spike in insider buying at sector level = bullish regime confirmation. Spike in selling = bearish. Use Perplexity: 'Which sectors have seen unusual insider buying/selling in past 3 months?'
data_sources: ['SEC Form 4 filings via Perplexity', 'Insider buy/sell ratios by sector', 'CEO/CFO transaction clustering']
signal: Insider_sentiment = (buy_volume - sell_volume) / total_volume. >0.3 = bullish, <-0.3 = bearish.
varma_dalio_fit: Insiders have informational edge. Varma: use all available info, not just price.

name: Remove Prediction, Keep Reaction
metaphor: Don't predict where the rock will be. React when you see it form. Less forecasting, more observation.
implementation: Eliminate all predictive models (ML forecasts, regression). Keep only reactive rules: IF price > 200DMA AND vol < 20th pct THEN size up. No 'stock will go to $X'. Ask Perplexity: 'What are best reactive (not predictive) trading frameworks?'
data_sources: ['Current regime state (observable)', 'Price relative to moving averages', 'Vol percentiles']
signal: No forecasts. Only state machines: current_state → action_rule → position_size.
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: reactive risk management, not predictive. Dalio: respond to what IS, not what you think will be.

name: Remove Trades in Neutral Regimes (Shi Absence)
metaphor: Don't surf when the water is flat (no rocks, no patterns). Wu wei: do nothing when no advantage.
implementation: When all indicators mid-range (trend neutral, vol normal, sentiment balanced), eliminate ALL trades. Only trade when regime extremes create clear advantage (Shi presence). Ask Perplexity: 'What are characteristics of low-conviction market environments?'
data_sources: ['Regime classification across 5 factors', 'Historical returns in neutral vs extreme regimes']
signal: Trade_allowed = (regime_extreme_count >= 2). If <2 factors at extremes, flat.
varma_dalio_fit: Wu wei: only act when natural advantage exists. Varma: don't force trades.

name: Remove Low-Confidence Patterns from Regime Influence
metaphor: Don't change your route (cut exposure) for every pebble (low-confidence signal). Only react to boulders (high-confidence).
implementation: In your early-warning system, patterns with confidence <40 get eliminated from MSI calculation (watchlist only). Don't let noise drive regime shifts. This is already in your spec (FR-EWR-024).
data_sources: ['Multi-source confidence scores', 'Historical false positive rates by confidence bucket']
signal: MSI_contribution = severity × confidence × stage_weight IF confidence >= 40 ELSE 0.
varma_dalio_fit: Varma: systematic rules prevent emotional overreaction to noise.

name: Pattern Failure Detection → Entry Signal
metaphor: When everyone falls off the rock (pattern fails), that's when you enter (contrarian).
implementation: Track momentum strategy failures. When 5-day momentum breaks down sharply (>2 stdev), it's often a shakeout before continuation. Use pattern failure as entry, not exit. Ask Perplexity: 'What are common false breakdowns in trending markets?'
data_sources: ['Pattern performance tracking', 'Drawdown depth vs regime', 'Failed pattern follow-through rates']
signal: Contrarian_entry = (pattern_breakdown > 2 stdev) AND (underlying_regime_still_supportive).
varma_dalio_fit: Kuzushi: off-balance moments create opportunity. Sentiment exhaustion → reversal.

name: High Correlation → Inverse Market Beta Strategies
metaphor: When everyone's surfing downstream (correlated), surf upstream (negative beta).
implementation: In HIGH correlation regimes, only trade strategies with negative or zero beta to SPY: long vol, merger arb, stat arb. Use Perplexity: 'Which strategies historically profit when equity correlations spike?'
data_sources: ['Strategy betas by regime', 'Correlation regime classification', 'Alternative strategy returns']
signal: Strategy_allowed = (strategy_beta < 0.3) OR (correlation_regime == LOW).
varma_dalio_fit: Dalio: diversification. Varma: don't crowd into correlated trades.

name: Inverse Institutional Flow → Liquidity Arb
metaphor: Institutions (big boats) can't surf the small, shallow rocks (illiquid stocks). That's where retail advantage is.
implementation: Track institutional ownership (13F). Stocks with <30% institutional ownership = less crowded, slower alpha decay. Use Perplexity: 'What trading patterns work best in low-institutional-ownership stocks?'
data_sources: ['13F institutional ownership data', 'Float turnover', 'Bid-ask spreads']
signal: Liquidity_edge = (inst_ownership < 30%) AND (market_cap < $5B). Small, illiquid = less competition.
varma_dalio_fit: From your SCAMPER brainstorm idea #14: institutional flow constraints create multi-year arb.
